info.title: Opnshelf API
info.description: Personal media tracker powered by AT Protocol

cast.description: Top-billed cast only; see cast_total and the credits endpoint

crew.description: Key crew only; see crew_total and the credits endpoint

cast_total.description: Cast members TMDB lists in total

crew_total.description: Crew credits TMDB lists in total

nextCursor.description: Cursor for next page (null if no more items)

username.description: Desired username (the subdomain label). Combined with the PDS handle domain, e.g. 'jane' -> jane.opnshelf.social

email.description: Email for the new PDS account

password.description: Password for the new PDS account

captchaToken.description: Cloudflare Turnstile token proving the request is human

sessionId.description: Opaque session id (also set as an httpOnly cookie)

username.description: Desired username (the subdomain label). Combined with the PDS handle domain, e.g. 'jane' -> jane.opnshelf.social

captchaToken.description: Cloudflare Turnstile token proving the request is human

coreOAuthUrl.description: Where to send the browser next: the PDS consent page for the OAuth request bound to this registration

displayName.description: The actor's display name, if set

avatar.description: URL of the actor's avatar, if set

authorizationUrl.description: Authorization URL for the cumulative OAuth permission set

needsOnboarding.description: Whether this user should complete onboarding

emailVerifiedAt.description: When the account's email was verified

needsEmailVerification.description: Whether this user must verify their email before writing records

showBlueskyOnProfile.description: Whether Bluesky link is shown on public profile

showTangledOnProfile.description: Whether Tangled link is shown on public profile

hasBlueskyProfile.description: Whether this DID resolves to a real Bluesky/AppView profile

code.description: The verification code from the signup email

verified.description: Whether the account is now verified

coreOAuthUrl.description: Core OAuth authorization URL. The bootstrap credential is revoked before this is returned.

deviceId.description: Opaque id of the install, used to revoke this device

isCurrent.description: Whether this is the device making the request

lastUsedAt.description: Last authenticated request from this device

revoked.description: How many devices were signed out

episodeWatchCount.description: Episode Watches logged for this show, rewatches included. Not a count of distinct episodes, and not a Watch count for the show itself — only movies and episodes are Watched.

totalEpisodes.description: Total aired non-special episodes for the show

episodesWatched.description: Distinct episodes the user has watched (non-special)

page.description: Current page number after server-side clamping

pageSize.description: Number of items returned per page

total.description: Total count of upcoming release items

nextCursor.description: Cursor for next page (null if no more items)

watchedAt.description: Custom watch datetime (ISO 8601). Null creates an undated Watch. If omitted, current time is used.
Custom watch datetime (ISO 8601). Null creates undated Watches. If omitted, current time is used.

count.description: Episodes successfully logged to the PDS and indexed

requested.description: Episodes attempted. count < requested means writes stopped early (e.g. PDS rate limit)

watchedAt.description: Custom watch datetime (ISO 8601). Null creates undated Watches. If omitted, current time is used.

date.description: UTC calendar day in YYYY-MM-DD form

count.description: Number of items watched on this day (rewatches included)

episodeWatchCount.description: Number of logged episode watches for this show in the past 30 days (rewatches included)

showBlueskyOnProfile.description: Whether Bluesky link is shown on public profile

showTangledOnProfile.description: Whether Tangled link is shown on public profile

activityLast30Days.description: Daily watch activity for the last 30 UTC days, oldest first (always 30 entries)

mostWatchedShow.description: The show with the most logged episode watches in the past 30 days, or null if none tracked

watchedThisYear.description: Items watched (movies + episodes) so far this calendar year, UTC

reviewsCount.description: Total number of reviews the user has written

circleIds.description: Ids of the viewer's circles this user belongs to. Only populated when the viewer requests their own following list.

watchCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for streaming availability (e.g., US, GB)

alwaysShowSpoilers.description: Reader preference: always show spoiler content, suppressing Spoiler Shields

reviewsPublicationUri.description: AT URI of the publication new reviews point at, or null for the opnshelf default

reviewsPublicationName.description: Cached display name of the chosen reviews publication

reviewsMirrorFormat.description: Explicit reader format used for blog mirrors; Markdown is the portable default

welcomeTourWebVersion.description: Welcome Tour version the Web App has finished; 0 means it has never run

welcomeTourMobileVersion.description: Welcome Tour version the Mobile App has finished; 0 means it has never run

watchCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for streaming availability (e.g., US, GB)

reviewsMirrorFormat.description: Explicit reader format for blog mirrors. Markdown is the portable default.

welcomeTourWebVersion.description: Welcome Tour version the Web App has finished. Send the client's current version on finish or skip, or 0 to replay it.

welcomeTourMobileVersion.description: Welcome Tour version the Mobile App has finished. Send the client's current version on finish or skip, or 0 to replay it.

isVip.description: Whether the profile has Trakt VIP

title.description: Primary display title for this watch item

subtitle.description: Secondary context for this watch item
